context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 役職/折衝/統括/取り寄せ/開演/切り上げ/一段落/振り回さ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の役職、変更がありました。
lines.en: There's been a change in the police department's organizational structure.
lines.style: Professional, measured. Clear enunciation on the key information. Steady eye contact. No rush. The tone of someone delivering a routine briefing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次回の折衝、新体制で行います。
lines.en: Understood. We'll proceed with the next round of negotiations under the new framework.
lines.style: Attentive, nodding slightly. Measured pace matching the officer's rhythm. A touch of resolution — committing to the adjustment without fuss.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 統括部署、現場との連携、強化中です。
lines.en: The central division and field operations are actively strengthening their coordination now.
lines.style: Methodical delivery. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening' — conveying ongoing progress. No flourish. Practical, factual tone of someone reporting status.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料、警察から取り寄せました。
lines.en: Yes. We've already obtained the necessary materials from the police department.
lines.style: Brief, efficient. A note of quiet competence — we're ahead of schedule. Calm confidence without any boasting. Professional shorthand between people who understand the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 合同会議、開演時間、お知らせします。
lines.en: I'll send you the details on the joint meeting's start time.
lines.style: Clear, direct. Slight emphasis on 'I'll' — taking ownership of the follow-up. Warm undertone beneath the formality. The professional who actually follows through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。打ち合わせ、早めに切り上げる予定です。
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to wrap up our internal coordination meeting early to make time.
lines.style: Responsive, slightly deferential but not weak. Shows he's listening and adjusting. Steady, pragmatic — no drama, just logistics aligned with the officer's needs.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯活動、一段落、評価会、開きます。
lines.en: Once the crime prevention activities reach a natural stopping point, we'll hold a formal review meeting.
lines.style: Deliberate pace. Slight weight on 'review' — signalling this is an important checkpoint. Composed, methodical. The voice of someone who sees the bigger arc of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の声に振り回されない冷静さ、保ちます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll maintain a calm, clear-headed perspective regardless of public opinion.
lines.style: Firm but not rigid. Conviction underneath — this is a principle, not just procedure. Measured delivery that carries quiet resolve. The commitment of someone who's thought this through.
